SELECT DISTINCT  RU.UNITJOB_NAME				  				
FROM PDS_CALLLIST CL
INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTDATE CD ON CL.CALLLIST_IID = CD.CALLLISTDATE_CALLLIST_IID           
INNER JOIN 
		(select Max(CALLLISTDATE_IID) as MAX_CALLLISTDATE_IID 
		from PDS_CALLLISTDATE
		Group by CALLLISTDATE_CALLLIST_IID) CD1 
ON  CD.CALLLISTDATE_IID =CD1.MAX_CALLLISTDATE_IID		
INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTMASTER CM ON CM.CALLLISTMASTER_CALLLISTDATE_IID = CD.CALLLISTDATE_IID
AND CM.CALLLISTMASTER_ACTIVE_IND = 0
INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTRULE CR ON CM.CALLLISTMASTER_INACTIVE_CALLLISTRULE_IID = CR.CALLLISTRULE_IID
INNER JOIN PDS_MEMBER M ON CM.CALLLISTMASTER_ENTITY_IID = M.MEMBER_IID	  
INNER JOIN  PDS_2008.dbo.PDS_CALLLIST_335_HISTORY HIST
ON HIST.CALLLIST_335_HISTORY_CASE_IID = CM.CALLLISTMASTER_EXTRADATA_IID
--LEFT JOIN DBO.PDS_CALLLIST_137_HEALTHPLAN_LOOKUP_INTERNAL HP ON M.MEMBER_IID=HP.MEMBER_IID	
LEFT OUTER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTSTATUS CS ON CM.CALLLISTMASTER_ENTITY_IID = CS.CALLLISTSTATUS_ENTITY_IID
AND CL.CALLLIST_IID = CS.CALLLISTSTATUS_CALLLIST_IID
LEFT OUTER JOIN PDS_DISPOSITIONCODE DC ON CS.CALLLISTSTATUS_LASTDISPOSITIONCODE_IID = DC.DISPOSITIONCODE_IID
INNER JOIN [dbo].[PDS_RPT_UNITJOB] RU ON RU.UNITJOB_IID = CM.CALLLISTMASTER_UNITJOB_IID
Where CL.CALLLIST_CD = '335'

SELECT DISTINCT  RU.UNITJOB_NAME          
FROM PDS_CALLLIST CL
INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTDATE CD ON CL.CALLLIST_IID = CD.CALLLISTDATE_CALLLIST_IID           
INNER JOIN 
  (select Max(CALLLISTDATE_IID) as MAX_CALLLISTDATE_IID 
  from PDS_CALLLISTDATE
  Group by CALLLISTDATE_CALLLIST_IID) CD1 
ON  CD.CALLLISTDATE_IID =CD1.MAX_CALLLISTDATE_IID  
INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTMASTER CM ON CM.CALLLISTMASTER_CALLLISTDATE_IID = CD.CALLLISTDATE_IID
AND CM.CALLLISTMASTER_ACTIVE_IND = 0
INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTRULE CR ON CM.CALLLISTMASTER_INACTIVE_CALLLISTRULE_IID = CR.CALLLISTRULE_IID
INNER JOIN PDS_MEMBER M ON CM.CALLLISTMASTER_ENTITY_IID = M.MEMBER_IID 
LEFT OUTER JOIN PDS_CALLLIST_335_HISTORY_TASKS CCNT 
ON CCNT.CALLLIST_335_HISTORY_TASK_IID = CM.CALLLISTMASTER_EXTRADATA_IID
AND CL.CALLLIST_CD ='342'
LEFT OUTER JOIN PDS_CALLLIST_335_HISTORY HIST
ON HIST.CALLLIST_335_HISTORY_CASE_IID = COALESCE(CCNT.CALLLIST_335_HISTORY_TASK_CASE_IID,CM.CALLLISTMASTER_EXTRADATA_IID)
AND CL.CALLLIST_CD ='342'
--LEFT JOIN DBO.PDS_CALLLIST_137_HEALTHPLAN_LOOKUP_INTERNAL HP ON M.MEMBER_IID=HP.MEMBER_IID 
LEFT OUTER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTSTATUS CS ON CM.CALLLISTMASTER_ENTITY_IID = CS.CALLLISTSTATUS_ENTITY_IID
AND CL.CALLLIST_IID = CS.CALLLISTSTATUS_CALLLIST_IID
LEFT OUTER JOIN PDS_DISPOSITIONCODE DC ON CS.CALLLISTSTATUS_LASTDISPOSITIONCODE_IID = DC.DISPOSITIONCODE_IID
INNER JOIN [dbo].[PDS_RPT_UNITJOB] RU ON RU.UNITJOB_IID = CM.CALLLISTMASTER_UNITJOB_IID
Where CL.CALLLIST_CD = '342'
